# Extended metrics upstream availability

Probe date: 2026-08-25.

Evidence source: the public intervals.icu OpenAPI document at `https://intervals.icu/api/v1/docs` (retrieved 2026-08-25), plus public forum posts cited per metric below. The OpenAPI lists these fields on `Activity`, `ActivityWithIntervals`, and `Interval` as numeric only; it establishes field presence and scope but not units. The maintainer's [post #19](https://forum.intervals.icu/t/working-on-advanced-running-metrics-gct-vertical-oscillation-vertical-ratio-step-length-help-us-cover-more-devices-before-we-ship-it/130701/19) confirms that the new interval averages were exposed, but does not document activity aggregation or units. Unit labels come from separate public forum reports: standard running-dynamics device-field mappings in [post #3](https://forum.intervals.icu/t/working-on-advanced-running-metrics-gct-vertical-oscillation-vertical-ratio-step-length-help-us-cover-more-devices-before-we-ship-it/130701/3) and [post #4](https://forum.intervals.icu/t/working-on-advanced-running-metrics-gct-vertical-oscillation-vertical-ratio-step-length-help-us-cover-more-devices-before-we-ship-it/130701/4), vertical-speed reporting in [post #56](https://forum.intervals.icu/t/vertical-speed/25781/56), and leg-spring-stiffness reporting in [post #13](https://forum.intervals.icu/t/intervals-icu-training-data-analysis/124492/13). These are community/device reports, not maintainer unit documentation. No local `.env`/credentials were used and no authenticated athlete payloads were committed. Fixtures in this directory are sanitized, schema-minimal examples that preserve only fields needed by tests and later tool shaping; they contain no API keys, raw athlete identifiers, exact activity IDs, GPS traces, free-text notes, or device serials.

Availability states:

- `yes`: directly exposed by a public API schema and safe to surface when present.
- `conditional`: directly exposed by a public API schema but only populated for qualifying sports/devices/activities; omit from `get_extended_metrics` responses when absent.
- `computed_not_allowed`: derivable from raw streams or zones but not directly exposed as the requested metric; do not compute in icuvisor.
- `not_observed`: plausible upstream/device feature, but no documented schema field or representative sample was available; do not expose until evidence is added.
- `unit_unverified`: a public schema names a numeric source field, but its unit or sport-specific semantics are not documented by permitted upstream evidence; retain it only in `include_full` until that evidence exists.
- `no`: checked public endpoint schemas and no direct upstream field exists; drop from the tool.

Checked endpoint/query families for unavailable fields: `GET /api/v1/athlete/{id}/activities?oldest&newest&fields`, `GET /api/v1/activity/{id}?intervals=true|false`, `GET /api/v1/activity/{id}/intervals`, `GET /api/v1/activity/{id}/streams{ext}?types&includeDefaults`, `GET /api/v1/activity/{id}/power-vs-hr{ext}`, `GET /api/v1/athlete/{id}/athlete-summary{ext}?start&end`, `GET /api/v1/athlete/{id}/wellness{ext}?oldest&newest&fields`, `GET /api/v1/athlete/{id}/events{format}?oldest&newest&resolve`, `GET /api/v1/activity/{id}/best-efforts`, and `GET /api/v1/athlete/{id}/power-curves{ext}`.

Implementation rule: expose only rows marked `yes` or `conditional`, and only emit a field when the upstream payload includes a non-null numeric value (including zero). Existing `stride_length_m` and `left_right_balance_percent` shaping is unchanged. Keep `average_cadence`, `min_cadence`, and `max_cadence` available only through `include_full:true` raw payloads until their unit and running-specific semantics are documented upstream. The running-dynamics fields below are emitted directly from activity and interval payloads with `_meta.metric_provenance`; `average_impact_loading_rate` is excluded from the typed response because its unit is unverified. Drop `ground_contact_time_ms`, `vertical_oscillation_cm`, `ground_contact_time_balance_percent`, `core_temperature_c`, `hr_drift_percent`, and `cadence_by_zone`; do not zero-fill or derive them from raw streams.
